pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: I'm telling you I gave them back! Every last one of them!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: ...Fine. If you really say that you returned all the Poké Balls that Essentia stole...

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: And I did! I returned them!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: And I'm turning myself in without a fight, so just give me a minute!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: There is no minute to give you! Our train is about to depart!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Haha! Here they come!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Because I contacted Emma, of course!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: I'm sure she'll be here any minute, too!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Where is he? Hold on! Wait for me, Mr. Looker!

action: q.run_command('execute unless entity @e[x=-294,y=108,z=443,dy=3,type=cobblemon:npc] run npcspawnat -294 108 443 looker_generic');
q.run_command('execute unless entity @e[x=-296,y=108,z=444,dy=3,type=cobblemon:pokemon] run pokespawnat -296 108 444 espurr level=30 no_ai=yes uncatchable=yes');

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Good timing, Emma!

action: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' if entity @s[tag=!RadioOff] run function kalos:triggers/stopsound');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' if entity @s[tag=!RadioOff] run playsound emmastheme record @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' if entity @s[tag=!RadioOff] run scoreboard players set @s MusicCooldown 119');

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Mr. Looker, I've been searching everywhere for you!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Please t-tell me why, please...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Why did you lie to us? Why are you leaving us behind?

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I...I'm sorry, Emma...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: But my letter explains everything.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I work for the International Police! I am a globe-trotting, crime-fighting elite!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Wherever there is a case, I must go! Justice awaits!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Then take me and Mimi with you. We'll join whatever police!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: We can be police or anything-- if only we can just stay together!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Emma, I wish it could be like that.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: You can't come. It's not possible at all.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Why not?! Why can't we?!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I'm part of the Looker Bureau, too! I'm your assistant, aren't I?!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: In fact, the time has come for you to graduate from being my assistant.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: As of this moment, I name you the new head of the Looker Bureau!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Wh-what?

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Listen to me, Emma. You were born and raised in this fair city.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Every day of your life, you have been here.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: You are the only one who knows this city inside and out.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: No one else could do the things you can do for it!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I pass my torch of brilliant detective-ing to you!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Take my place, and keep protecting the peace of Lumiose City!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: But that's not fair at all!

lines.expression: 'Come on, ' + q.player.username + '! Say something! Tell him he\'s wrong!';

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Emma, please. I must ask you to respect the necessity of my decision.

lines.expression: '' + q.player.username + ' understands perfectly why I must go. It is the way of partners.';

pages.speaker: looker
lines: They are my partner. We understand each other.

pages.speaker: mimi
lines: Mrrrawrrr...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Oh, Mimi... Please don't make a sad face on my account.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: No matter where I go, our bonds will never change.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: You will be my dear friends from the Looker Bureau, always and forever.

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Yes! That is it! Bonds!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: The preposterous notion which cannot be seen nor measured!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: And yet I cannot deny that they do still exist!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Fear not, Emma, for I suspect that you will always be tied to the International Police by your bonds!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Dr. Xerosic...

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Emma! I give you my Expansion Suit!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: I have removed the remote-control functionality, so you needn't worry!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: As the new head detective in town, please use your powers as Essentia to protect your beloved Lumiose City!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: And...and...

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Please take all of the Pokémon that I raised for so long! They are yours now!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Dr. Xerosic... Dr. Xerosic, you've tried to do terrible things to the world, I guess.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I find it hard to see you as that kind of person.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I only became a Pokémon Trainer thanks to your being there for me.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: ... ... ... I will always cherish your Pokémon and your suit, Dr. Xerosic.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I won't forget our bonds, either...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Everyone... I'm sorry, but...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: We are nearly out of time. Our train is due to depart.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Mr. Looker... I think I understand...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: And I know what I'm gonna do. I'll keep on working hard for you.

lines.expression: 'I\'ve got Mimi and ' + q.player.username + ' to help me.';

pages.speaker: emma
lines: With Dr. Xerosic's Pokémon and Expansion Suit, I will become the new head of the Looker Bureau!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I leave it in your hands, Emma!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I'll rest easy, knowing you're on the case!

pages.speaker: xerosic
lines: Emma! Don't you mess this up, my girl!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I entrust to you three the great task of protecting the peace of Lumiose City!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Thank you for everything! Farewell, my friends!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Thank you... And good-bye...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: That's enough...

pages.speaker: mimi
lines: Muuurrrawr...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Hey, Mimi?

pages.speaker: emma
lines: You know, we've made a lot of really good friends since we left the alleys...

lines.expression: '' + q.player.username + ' and Mr. Looker... And Dr. Xerosic, too...';

pages.speaker: mimi
lines: Mrawr! Mrawwwr!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Mimi... Those two old guys really did everything for us...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Do you think that's what it's like...to have a father?

pages.speaker: mimi
lines: Mrawr?

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Hehehe... Nothing. Never mind.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Of course you wouldn't know any better than me, Mimi.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: But...I'm still glad. I'm glad we got to meet them.

pages.speaker: mimi
lines: Mrrrrrrawr!
